en.headline: Police lead 2,600-person drill for November Interpol General Assembly
en.dek: The overnight exercise at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, Victoria Harbour and West Kowloon tested crowd management, transport coordination and response to a simulated terrorist attack.
body: The Police Force, together with multiple government departments and organisations, conducted a large-scale inter-departmental exercise overnight on Tuesday to prepare for the 94th Interpol General Assembly to be held in Hong Kong at the end of November.

More than 2,600 personnel took part, covering scenarios that included managing the movement of about 1,000 delegates between venues, water and land transport coordination, wireless network stress testing, and emergency response to a simulated vehicle-ramming and shooting attack at the conference venue that caused mass casualties, together with the simultaneous evacuation of a nearby educational institution.

Commissioner of Police Chow Yat-ming inspected the exercise. The government said the drill tested tactical intervention, casualty triage, handling of suspicious items and care of affected persons, aiming to strengthen Hong Kong’s readiness to host the international policing event.

zh.headline: 警聯同多部門演練 為11月底國際刑警大會作準備
zh.dek: 逾2600人參與的跨部門演習於會展、維港及西九一帶進行，模擬人流管理、交通協調及恐襲應變，警務處處長周一鳴到場視察。
body: 為確保今年11月底在香港舉行的國際刑警組織第94屆全體大會順利進行，警務處周二晚聯同多個政府部門及機構，在香港會議展覽中心、維多利亞港及西九龍一帶進行跨部門綜合演習。
演習動員超過2600名人員，涵蓋模擬約1000名與會代表在會場內的人流管理及往返安排、水陸交通指揮協調、無線網絡壓力測試，以及處理突發狀況的應急部署。其中一個情景模擬恐怖分子駕車衝入會場並發動槍擊，釀成大量傷亡，同時鄰近院校須緊急疏散。
警務處處長周一鳴到場視察，讚揚各部門專業表現及協調配合。政府表示，演習全面測試即時戰術介入、傷者分流急救、處理可疑物品及受影響人士等環節，進一步提升跨部門反恐準備及事故應變能力。
